subject: VM scan cadence, forensics handback, and ownership delegation
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@fintrust.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: FinTrust Security <secops@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM scan cadence + forensics handback for SIG

Connor —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG review (FT-12345) we need: a clear statement of your vulnerability scan cadence (internal/external), proof that critical CVEs are triaged within your SLA window, and a forensics handback process for when we request packet/log artifacts during an incident review. Our audit team will accept a short attestation that describes the cadence and the owner(s) responsible for remediation along with sample artifacts.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday that you can provide: 1) recent scan results covering the last 30 days; 2) a CVE commit log for P1/P2 fixes; and 3) a brief forensics handback playbook or pointer to where artifacts will be exported?

We're trying to close SIG questions this week. If you need a POA or escalation please let me know.

Appreciate it,
Megan Liu
Senior Security Manager, FinTrust
megan.liu@fintrust.com
[FinTrust: SIG intake reference FT-12345]
From: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@fintrust.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM scan cadence + forensics handback for SIG

Megan —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front:
- Scan cadence: internal nightly authenticated scans + weekly external (credentialed) vulnerability scans; monthly third-party pentest on a rolling schedule.
- SLA: Critical (P1) CVEs are targeted for triage within 24 hours and remediation or mitigation within 30 days (exceptions routed to security@redwood.ai).
- Forensics handback: we can provide sanitized packet captures and relevant logs within a secured S3 share; for sensitive requests we use an HMAC-signed transfer and an evidence manifest.

Attached are: redwood-vm-scan-summary-20261010.csv (last 30 days), redwood-cve-commit-log-20261012.xlsx (P1/P2 fixes the last 60 days), and a short playbook excerpt (detection-playbook.pdf) that describes artifact export.

If that satisfies SIG, we can follow with a one-paragraph attestation on Redwood letterhead that the above cadence and SLA are in effect and listing named owners. For the attestation owners we propose: Kimberly Park (VM program owner) and Monica Patel (Security engineering lead).

Next steps I propose:
1) We provide the attestation PDF and the signed S3 share link to you by Wed 10/14 10:00 PT.
2) If FinTrust needs an expanded forensics export (pcap-level), we will require a signed NDA or limited-scope ECA for export and will coordinate with your SecOps contact.

cc'ing Kimberly and Monica to confirm owners and ETA.

-Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

[attachment: redwood-cve-commit-log-20261012.xlsx (XLSX, 240KB)]

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM scan cadence + forensics handback for SIG

Megan / Connor / Team —

Confirming I own the VM program and will be the primary point for attestations and evidence handback. Monica will handle technical exports and playbook execution; Jonas will be backup for escalation windows.

A few clarifications for the attestation and forensics handback:
- Attestation will be a one-paragraph statement on company letterhead signed by me; it will describe cadence (nightly internal, weekly external), SLA for critical CVEs (24h triage / 30d remediation), and the named owners.
- For forensic artifacts we will provide a secure S3 link with an evidence manifest (checksum + HMAC) and a short chain-of-custody note. Full pcap exports are available but require an additional ECA.
- Timeline: we will publish the attestation and the secure share link by Wed 2026-10-14 10:00 PT. If FinTrust needs anything sooner, please escalate to security@redwood.ai.

Attached is a redacted sample manifest for your reference (included in the CSV/XLSX package).

Kimberly Park
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
[attachment referenced: evidence-manifest-sample.txt (TXT, 4KB)]
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@fintrust.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: FinTrust Security <secops@fintrust.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM scan cadence + forensics handback for SIG

Thanks Kimberly / Connor —

That works. We appreciate the sign-off and the chain-of-custody approach. One quick ask before you finalize the attestation: include the Jira/issue-tracking pattern you use to track P1/P2 fixes (so we can map the commit log to ticketing IDs). Otherwise the CSV/XLSX look good to start the SIG close.

We'll accept the attestation and secure share at the timeline you proposed. If you need a signed ECA for pcaps we'll send a template.

Best,
Megan
Senior Security Manager, FinTrust
